subject: fix(gdn): order fresh-state prefill output reads
requirement: Preserve fresh-request output and recurrent-state reproducibility in native Xe2 GDN prefill. The B70 Qwen3.8-27B BF16 TP1 projection has 16 K heads, 48 V heads, D128 and 64-token chunks. The first chunk with no prior state shares its O2 matrix across subgroups.
upstream_coverage: At v0.1.17, csrc/xpu/gdn_attn/xe_2/chunk_gated_delta_rule_kernels_xe2.hpp is blob b457f3d06213cf141dfed99d0ed1a6a4b387dc7f, identical to the frozen old upstream base. In gdn::chunk_fwd_o_kernel, subgroup writes to O2 at 1086–1087 precede reads via gemm_TTS at 1223. The barrier at 1160 only executes with previous state. The fresh first chunk has no cross-subgroup fence after the writes. Its branch condition is uniform across the workgroup.

Kernel commits b73bdc317dd9f38f905a866e579855cec8459a08 (null state), 11c79175cddab23e76b7bfaf6b3df2538185e888 (convolution layout), daf624051e617bac77c4e1de6f13c6a1d83f9e57 (64-bit convolution offsets) and 78799feacc02fd2fd52fe01b847ae5ae681b9627 (speculative RecoverSSM) preserve this non-speculative prefill path. At the target, gdn_attn_interface.cpp:811–817 still dispatches prefill to chunk_gated_delta_rule_xe2.

In vLLM v0.34.0, _resolve_gdn_prefill_backend in qwen_gdn_linear_attn.py retains the auto-selected SYCL path when the native op is available. Qwen forward calls gdn_attention_core_xpu at 1461, and vllm/_xpu_ops.py:233 calls torch.ops._xpu_C.gdn_attention. An explicit Triton backend can bypass this path; the shipped Xe2 native path still requires synchronization.
minimum_residual: Keep sycl::group_barrier(item.get_group()) immediately inside if (!has_prev_state), before the output dv loop, together with fresh-state, split/carry and asynchronous replay tests in tests/gdn_attn/test_gdn_attn.py. The current fix is already scoped to that branch.
dependencies: Independent native ordering fix. Parent 63a31d0 guards a different kernel. Some replay tests also exercise e50d437 deterministic W4A16 projections. Neither those changes nor d8e1f69 mixed-batch dispatch orders O2. No changes to PyTorch operator schema or vLLM ABI are required. The fixed header blob 2db48c2fed78a6bcc92356d1431261704848c2af remains present at the final old kernel tip.

performed: Confirmed blob identity and inspected both fresh and carried-state branches, source dispatch chain, and relevant upstream commit history.
